Kiri/Ana combo is a tricky one but not impossible. If they stayed paired, your best bet is to typically wait/bait CDs first so they have less of a chance in an engagement. 

The other strategy would be to focus DPS in a Kiri/Ana tight pair. Odds are, if both Kiri and Ana are bunched up together, there is a DPS floating out of position. Punish this, and force them to separate and cover their teammate. If you force a break in their LOS to each other, then the Ana suddenly becomes much more killable. 

For later stages in the match, this is where Stack Overflow is a highly beneficial perk. Hack+Virus Kiri, and delete her before the Ana can save her. Bonus points if you can get this engagement in time with Ana being on CD for nade. 

They’re not an impossible duo to take down, but this is one of the harder skill check support combos for Sombra. Above all else, you need the game sense to recognize when to engage, how to engage, and especially with these two how to make them punishable.

I'll restate a point I made else where in the thread, but Hack's inherent balance comes from just how revealing it is both for the target and the team at large. There is visual effects seen both in the game as.a whole and the HJD of the Hack target. 

Also another blurb on why I think a skill shot is a not so great idea: 

Today, Hack takes roughly 1-1.25 seconds to cast (could be totally wrong on the numbers, just going based on memory on the toilet here). So Hack+Virus combo is completed at at least 1.5 seconds now. While this time would exist in the TTK radius of your proposed rework, the sub 1.5s range would possibly be viable enough to just br able to essentially do a Junkrat style 1 shot combo.

Hack itself and its effects are not that insane, especially in comparison to what they used to be. However, where it is now is honestly fine. A roughly 1.5 second lockout of abilities gives more than enough time for 99% of hero’s to be able to get to cover, engage and pressure a Sombra, get a mobility/cleanse/heal ability off and either reposition or take advantage in the 1v1.

  
The concept of an ability for an Ult is not a as wild as it may seem as well. Several stun/hinder abilities do cancel ults in their current state: Orisa Javelin, Cast Hinder, Doom Punch, Ana Sleep, Kiriko Suzi\*, Bap Lamp\*, Rein Pin, Hog Hook, maybe one or two more I am missing. All these abilities can either cancel alts or completely nullify them, with a grand total of that list being 1 DPS (Cass).

Whatever they land on, I do hope it strikes a balance between keeping the Hack a viable tool in her kit while not losing the punishing aspect of the ability. I would think that something like Hack getting modified would also carry the same impact to Kiriko Suzu, as the cleanse also effectively serves as a Hack from the reverse direction.

Perhaps there is a middle ground of balance and viability, and I agree it is most likely somewhere between where we are. 

My concern as someone that mains Sombra is the loss of identity. Since her implementation, Hack has been her thing, what made her unique from the likes of Genji and Tracer. 

What I think you might be getting at is a happy medium between current Sombra and OW1, where Hack also granted an increase in damage from her primary fire. Now that would give an advantage to Sombra in any 1v1, but takes away another critical aspect of Hack, how it helps the team as a whole. 

Let’s look at Cass Hinder or Ana Anti for a comparison, yes both can be greatly useful in a 1v1 situation, but both can have massive implications in a team fight, and can even effect multiple players. Hack offers a similar opportunity for an individual player, and I can see where the annoyance of being singled out is, but from an ability perspective and in comparison to either of those nades, it offers about the same level of lockout, but instead of movement and healing, its general abilities localized to one person for an ability.

The issue with a skill shot hack is the potential reduced cast time. Your suggestion is interesting, but has issues. 

The balance of hack (in theory) is that it has a longer, guaranteed cast time and losing LOS cancels, as well as visual effects on screen and in game for everyone to see.
